properties.name: The eastern lords advance on Hulao Pass
properties.text: the eastern lords, 190, chapters 5. The coalition moves from Suanzao to the passes guarding Luoyang (in the novel, Hua Xiong and the three heroes against Lü Bu).
properties.text_zh: 关东诸侯，190年，第5回。关东联军自酸枣进逼汜水关、虎牢关（小说中温酒斩华雄、三英战吕布即在此）。

properties.name: Sun Jian fights his way to Luoyang
properties.text: the Sun / Wu, 190–191, chapters 5–6. Sun Jian beats Dong Zhuo's army at Yangren and is first into the burned capital.
properties.text_zh: 孙氏·吴，190–191年，第5–6回。孙坚阳人破董卓军，率先进入被焚的洛阳。

properties.name: Dong Zhuo drags the court west
properties.text: Dong Zhuo, 190, chapters 6. Dong Zhuo burns Luoyang and forces the emperor and a million people west to Chang'an.
properties.text_zh: 董卓，190年，第6回。董卓焚洛阳，驱赶天子与百万百姓西迁长安。

properties.name: Cao Cao pursues Dong Zhuo alone
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 190, chapters 6. Cao Cao alone pursues, and is routed by Xu Rong on the Bian River.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，190年，第6回。诸侯中唯曹操追击，在汴水被徐荣击败。

properties.name: Cao Cao's revenge on Xuzhou
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 193–194, chapters 10–11. Cao Cao marches from Yan province into Xuzhou to avenge his father.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，193–194年，第10–11回。曹操自兖州攻入徐州，为父报仇。

properties.name: Lü Bu seizes Yan province
properties.text: Lü Bu, 194–195, chapters 11–12. With Chen Gong and Zhang Miao, Lü Bu takes Yan province behind Cao Cao's back.
properties.text_zh: 吕布，194–195年，第11–12回。吕布得陈宫、张邈之助，趁曹操东征袭取兖州。

properties.name: The emperor's flight east
properties.text: the Han court, 195–196, chapters 13. The court escapes Chang'an, is chased and robbed, crosses the Yellow River at night and comes home to the ruins of Luoyang.
properties.text_zh: 汉廷，195–196年，第13回。献帝逃出长安，一路被追兵抢掠，夜渡黄河，回到满目疮痍的洛阳。

properties.name: Cao Cao takes the emperor to Xu
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 196, chapters 14. Cao Cao brings the court from Luoyang to his base at Xu.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，196年，第14回。曹操将朝廷从洛阳迁到自己的根据地许县。

properties.name: Sun Ce crosses the Yangzi and takes Jiangdong
properties.text: the Sun / Wu, 194–196, chapters 15. From Liyang Sun Ce crosses at Niuzhu and takes Qu'e, Wu and Kuaiji in two years.
properties.text_zh: 孙氏·吴，194–196年，第15回。孙策自历阳牛渚渡江，两年间取曲阿、吴郡、会稽。

properties.name: Cao Cao marches on Wan
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 197, chapters 16. Zhang Xiu surrenders and then rises in the night; Dian Wei dies at the gate.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，197年，第16回。张绣先降后反，夜袭曹营，典韦战死。

properties.name: Cao Cao marches on Lü Bu
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 198, chapters 18–19. Cao Cao takes Pengcheng, floods Xiapi and ends Lü Bu at the White Gate Tower.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，198年，第18–19回。曹操攻取彭城，水淹下邳，白门楼斩吕布。

properties.name: Yuan Shao comes south
properties.text: Yuan Shao, 200, chapters 25–30. Yan Liang besieges Baima; the main army crosses the Yellow River at Yanjin and closes on Guandu.
properties.text_zh: 袁绍，200年，第25–30回。颜良围白马，袁绍主力自延津渡河，进逼官渡。

properties.name: Cao Cao holds Guandu
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 200, chapters 25–30. Cao Cao comes up from Xu to Guandu, and rides out to relieve Baima, where Guan Yu kills Yan Liang.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，200年，第25–30回。曹操自许都进屯官渡，并出兵解白马之围，关羽斩颜良。

properties.name: The night raid on Wuchao
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 200, chapters 30. Cao Cao leads five thousand men under Yuan banners to burn Yuan Shao's grain.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，200年，第30回。曹操亲率五千人打着袁军旗号夜袭乌巢，焚烧袁绍粮草。

properties.name: Cao Cao takes the north
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 202–205, chapters 31–33. After Guandu Cao Cao crosses the river, takes Ye and pursues Yuan Tan to Nanpi.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，202–205年，第31–33回。官渡之后曹操渡河北上，攻克邺城，追斩袁谭于南皮。

properties.name: Beyond the Wall to White Wolf Mountain
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 207, chapters 33. Through the Lulong pass and five hundred li of empty country to White Wolf Mountain and Liucheng.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，207年，第33回。出卢龙塞，穿越五百里荒野，直抵白狼山、柳城。

properties.name: Cao Cao comes south
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 208, chapters 40–42. Liu Cong surrenders; Cao Cao's cavalry ride three hundred li in a day and night to catch Liu Bei at Changban.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，208年，第40–42回。刘琮投降，曹操轻骑一日一夜行三百余里，在长坂追上刘备。

properties.name: Liu Bei flees south with the people
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 208, chapters 41–42. From Fancheng past Xiangyang to Changban, then east to the Han ford and Xiakou.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，208年，第41–42回。自樊城经襄阳南撤至长坂，再东走汉津，到达夏口。

properties.name: Cao Cao's fleet comes down the Yangzi
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 208, chapters 45–48. From Jiangling the northern army sails down to Wulin, facing the Red Cliffs.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，208年，第45–48回。曹军自江陵顺江东下，屯兵乌林，与赤壁隔江相望。

properties.name: Zhou Yu sails west to the Red Cliffs
properties.text: the Sun / Wu, 208, chapters 44–49. Zhou Yu and Cheng Pu bring thirty thousand men up the river from Chaisang.
properties.text_zh: 孙氏·吴，208年，第44–49回。周瑜、程普率三万水军自柴桑溯江西上。

properties.name: Liu Bei joins Zhou Yu
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 208, chapters 44–49. From Xiakou Liu Bei moves to Fankou and joins the Wu fleet.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，208年，第44–49回。刘备自夏口移屯樊口，与东吴水军会合。

properties.name: Cao Cao's retreat by Huarong
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 208, chapters 50. Through the marshes to Jiangling, then north to Xu, leaving Cao Ren to hold Jiangling.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，208年，第50回。曹操经华容道穿越沼泽退至江陵，留曹仁守江陵，自己北还许都。

properties.name: Zhou Yu besieges Jiangling
properties.text: the Sun / Wu, 209, chapters 51. A year's siege of Cao Ren in Jiangling.
properties.text_zh: 孙氏·吴，209年，第51回。周瑜围攻据守江陵的曹仁一年。

properties.name: Liu Bei takes the four southern commanderies
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 209, chapters 52–53. Zhang Fei to Wuling, Guan Yu to Changsha, Zhao Yun to Guiyang, Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang to Lingling.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，209年，第52–53回。张飞取武陵，关羽取长沙，赵云取桂阳，刘备、诸葛亮取零陵。

properties.name: Cao Cao to Tong Pass and across the Yellow River
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 211, chapters 58–59. Cao Cao faces Ma Chao at Tong Pass, slips across the river at Puban and wins south of the Wei.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，211年，第58–59回。曹操在潼关与马超对峙，从蒲阪津北渡黄河，再南渡渭水，大破关中联军。

properties.name: Ma Chao marches on Tong Pass
properties.text: Ma Chao, 211, chapters 58. Ma Chao and Han Sui bring the armies of the northwest to Tong Pass.
properties.text_zh: 马超，211年，第58回。马超、韩遂率关西诸军进据潼关。

properties.name: Liu Bei goes up the Yangzi into Shu
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 211–212, chapters 60–62. Invited by Liu Zhang, Liu Bei sails up through the gorges to Jiangzhou, meets Liu Zhang at Fu and goes on to Jiameng.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，211–212年，第60–62回。应刘璋之邀，刘备溯江穿越三峡到江州，在涪城与刘璋相会，再北上葭萌。

properties.name: Liu Bei turns on Liu Zhang
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 212–214, chapters 62–65. From Jiameng back south through Fu and Luo to Chengdu, while Zhuge Liang, Zhang Fei and Zhao Yun come up the river from Jiangzhou.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，212–214年，第62–65回。刘备自葭萌回师，经涪城、雒城南下成都；诸葛亮、张飞、赵云自江州溯江分路来会。

properties.name: Cao Cao at Ruxu
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 213, chapters 61. Cao Cao comes south from Hefei to the Ruxu dyke; after a month he goes home.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，213年，第61回。曹操自合肥南下濡须口，相持月余而还。

properties.name: Sun Quan holds Ruxu
properties.text: the Sun / Wu, 213, chapters 61. Sun Quan comes up from Jianye to hold the fort at Ruxu.
properties.text_zh: 孙氏·吴，213年，第61回。孙权自建业进屯濡须坞。

properties.name: Sun Quan marches on Hefei
properties.text: the Sun / Wu, 215, chapters 67. A hundred thousand men against Hefei, until Zhang Liao's eight hundred charge at Xiaoyao Ford.
properties.text_zh: 孙氏·吴，215年，第67回。孙权率十万大军进攻合肥，被张辽八百人在逍遥津冲破。

properties.name: Cao Cao takes Hanzhong
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 215, chapters 67. Through the Dasan Pass and over the mountains to Yangping, where Zhang Lu's defences give way.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，215年，第67回。曹操出散关翻越秦岭，攻破阳平关，张鲁投降。

properties.name: Liu Bei marches on Hanzhong
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 218–219, chapters 70–72. From Chengdu by the Jinniu road to Yangping Pass and Mount Dingjun, where Huang Zhong kills Xiahou Yuan.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，218–219年，第70–72回。刘备自成都经金牛道北上阳平关、定军山，黄忠斩夏侯渊。

properties.name: Cao Cao comes to save Hanzhong, and leaves
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 219, chapters 71–72. Down the Xie valley road to Yangping; after months of stalemate, 'chicken rib', and back the same way.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，219年，第71–72回。曹操经褒斜道南下阳平，相持数月，以“鸡肋”为令，原路撤回。

properties.name: Guan Yu marches north
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 219, chapters 73–74. From Jiangling up the Han to Xiangyang and Fancheng, where the autumn floods drown seven armies.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，219年，第73–74回。关羽自江陵沿汉水北上，围攻襄阳、樊城，秋雨汉水泛滥，水淹七军。

properties.name: Xu Huang relieves Fancheng
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 219, chapters 76. From Wan, Xu Huang breaks through Guan Yu's siege lines.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，219年，第76回。徐晃自宛城南下，冲破关羽的围城营垒。

properties.name: Lü Meng crosses in white
properties.text: the Sun / Wu, 219, chapters 75. From Xunyang, soldiers hidden in merchant boats, past the beacons to Gong'an and Jiangling.
properties.text_zh: 孙氏·吴，219年，第75回。吕蒙自寻阳出发，精兵藏于商船，白衣摇橹，袭取公安、江陵。

properties.name: Guan Yu's last retreat
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 219, chapters 76–77. Jiangling lost behind him, Guan Yu falls back to Maicheng and breaks out towards Shu, to the ambush at Linju.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，219年，第76–77回。后方江陵已失，关羽退守麦城，突围西走，在临沮遭伏被擒。

properties.name: Liu Bei marches down the gorges against Wu
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 221–222, chapters 81–84. From Chengdu down the Yangzi through Baidi and Zigui to Yiling and Xiaoting.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，221–222年，第81–84回。刘备自成都顺江东下，经白帝、秭归，进抵夷陵、猇亭。

properties.name: Lu Xun's counter-attack
properties.text: the Sun / Wu, 222, chapters 84. Lu Xun fires the Shu camps one after another along the river.
properties.text_zh: 孙氏·吴，222年，第84回。陆逊沿江火攻，连破蜀军四十余营。

properties.name: Liu Bei flees to Baidi
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 222, chapters 84–85. The beaten army falls back up the gorges to Baidi, where Liu Bei will die.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，222年，第84–85回。蜀军大败，刘备溯江退回白帝城，次年病逝于此。

properties.name: Zhuge Liang marches south
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 225, chapters 87–90. From Chengdu by Bodao and Yuexi, across the Lu in the fifth month, to Dian and Wei.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，225年，第87–90回。诸葛亮自成都经僰道、越巂，五月渡泸，深入南中。

properties.name: First expedition: through Qishan
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 228, chapters 91–95. Out through Qishan; three commanderies go over; Ma Su loses Jieting.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，228年，第91–95回。出祁山，三郡响应，马谡失街亭。

properties.name: Zhao Yun's decoy at Ji Valley
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 228, chapters 92. The decoy column up the Ji Valley road.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，228年，第92回。赵云率疑兵出箕谷。

properties.name: Sima Yi's march on Meng Da
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 228, chapters 94. Twelve hundred li in eight days from Wan to Xincheng.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，228年，第94回。司马懿自宛城八日行一千二百里，奔袭新城孟达。

properties.name: Zhang He to Jieting
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 228, chapters 95. From Chang'an over the Long road to Jieting, where he cuts off Ma Su's water.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，228年，第95回。张郃自长安越陇关西进街亭，断马谡汲水之道。

properties.name: Second expedition: Chencang
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 228, chapters 97–98. Through the Dasan Pass against Hao Zhao's Chencang.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，228年，第97–98回。出散关，围攻郝昭据守的陈仓。

properties.name: Third expedition: Wudu and Yinping
properties.name_zh: 第三次北伐：取武都阴平
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 229, chapters 99. Chen Shi takes Wudu and Yinping.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，229年，第99回。陈式攻取武都、阴平。

properties.name: Fourth expedition: Qishan and Shanggui
properties.name_zh: 第四次北伐：出祁山割麦
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 231, chapters 101. Out through Qishan to reap the wheat at Shanggui; Zhang He dies at Mumen in the retreat.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，231年，第101回。出祁山，割上邽之麦，退兵时于木门道射杀张郃。

properties.name: Fifth expedition: up the Xie valley to Wuzhang
properties.name_zh: 第五次北伐：出斜谷屯五丈原
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 234, chapters 102–104. Up the Xie valley road to the Wuzhang plains, a hundred days facing Sima Yi across the Wei.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，234年，第102–104回。经褒斜道北出斜谷，屯兵五丈原，与司马懿隔渭水对峙百余日。

properties.name: Sima Yi marches on Liaodong
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 238, chapters 106. Four thousand li from Luoyang to Xiangping.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，238年，第106回。司马懿自洛阳远征四千里，直抵襄平。

properties.name: Jiang Wei's march to the Tao
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 255, chapters 110. Jiang Wei's greatest victory, west of the Tao at Didao.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，255年，第110回。姜维出兵洮西，大破魏军于狄道。

properties.name: Jiang Wei's march to Duangu
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 256, chapters 111. Out through Qishan towards Shanggui; Deng Ai is waiting at Duangu.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，256年，第111回。姜维出祁山向上邽，被邓艾在段谷击败。

properties.name: Jiang Wei through the Luo valley
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 257, chapters 112. Through the Luo valley to the grain stores at Changcheng.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，257年，第112回。姜维出骆谷，直逼长城囤粮处。

properties.name: Zhong Hui invades through Hanzhong
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 263, chapters 116–117. A hundred thousand men through the Luo valley into Hanzhong, then south to Jiange, where Jiang Wei holds him.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，263年，第116–117回。钟会率十余万大军经骆谷入汉中，南下至剑阁，被姜维挡住。

properties.name: Deng Ai through the Yinping wilderness
properties.text: Cao Cao / Wei, 263, chapters 117–118. From Didao against Jiang Wei at Tazhong, then seven hundred li of trackless mountains to Jiangyou, Mianzhu and Chengdu.
properties.text_zh: 曹操·魏，263年，第117–118回。邓艾自狄道攻沓中，再穿越七百里无人山区，经江油、绵竹，直取成都。

properties.name: Jiang Wei falls back to Jiange
properties.text: Liu Bei / Shu, 263, chapters 116–117. From Tazhong past Yinping to the pass at Jiange.
properties.text_zh: 刘备·蜀，263年，第116–117回。姜维自沓中经阴平退守剑阁。

properties.name: Wang Jun's fleet comes down the Yangzi
properties.text: Jin, 279–280, chapters 120. From Chengdu down the whole Yangzi, burning the chains across the gorges, to Jianye.
properties.text_zh: 晋，279–280年，第120回。王濬楼船自成都顺江而下，烧断横江铁锁，直抵建业。

properties.name: Du Yu takes Jiangling
properties.text: Jin, 279–280, chapters 120. From Xiangyang south to Jiangling, 'like splitting bamboo'.
properties.text_zh: 晋，279–280年，第120回。杜预自襄阳南下攻克江陵，势如破竹。

properties.name: Wang Hun comes down to the river
properties.text: Jin, 279–280, chapters 120. From Shouchun to the north bank opposite Jianye.
properties.text_zh: 晋，279–280年，第120回。王浑自寿春南下，进至建业对岸的江北。
